Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Jenna and I appreciated the concise walkthrough. A couple of quick notes and next steps from our side after internal sync: 

- Stakeholders: Jenna Lewis (CTO / technical champion), Mark Delaney (CFO / economic buyer), Erica Meyers (Head of Security) who will own the security questionnaire and SSO/KMS details. Procurement is handled by procurement@finovate.com and typically wants all commercial terms + SOC2 evidence.
